This report validates saved simulation summaries and Wilson intervals, then exports
8 Appendix C PDFs. **It does not rerun simulations**. `R/appendix_plots.R` handles
paths, validation and plotting, loaded through `R/load_workflow.R`. Keep the complete
repository structure and input CSV.

## Run and parameters

From the project root:

```r
rmarkdown::render("reports/04_plot_appendix_C.Rmd")
```

From another directory, pass this file's absolute path to `rmarkdown::render()`.
Override YAML parameters with `params = list(...)`:

| Parameter | Default | Purpose |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `input_csv` | `data/comparison_summary.csv` | Saved simulation summary |
| `figure_dir` | `results/figures` | Output directory for 8 PDFs |

Relative parameter paths resolve from the repository root;
absolute paths are also accepted. Missing output directories are created, and existing
PDFs with matching names are replaced. HTML rendering requires `rmarkdown`, `knitr`
and Pandoc; validation and PDF plotting use base R only.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE)
.slads_input_path <- normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE),
                                   winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(dirname(.slads_input_path), "..", "R", "load_workflow.R"),
  local = knitr::knit_global())
.workflow <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
slads_load_workflow("appendix", .slads_input_path, envir = .workflow)
plot_spec <- .workflow$appendix_plot_spec()
```

## Validate the design and Wilson intervals

Select $m=150$, $p\in\{10,40\}$, C1–C4, the 15 specified distribution pairs and
6 methods below: **2 × 4 × 15 × 6 = 720 cells**, each appearing exactly once.
Legacy method names `Chang` and `Wang` become `CZZW` and `WZZ` before duplicate checks.

```{r method-table}
knitr::kable(plot_spec$method_table, row.names = FALSE)
```

For $r$ rejections in $n$ valid replications, let $\widehat q=r/n$ and $z=\Phi^{-1}(0.975)$.
The 95% Wilson interval is

\[
\frac{\widehat q+z^2/(2n)\ \pm\ z\sqrt{\widehat q(1-\widehat q)/n+z^2/(4n^2)}}
     {1+z^2/n}.
\]

Each cell must have 1,000 valid replications, nominal level 0.05 and confidence level 0.95.
If present, `B`, `failed` and `complete` must indicate 1,000 draws, zero failures and completion.
Rejection rates, interval limits, and available MCSE and conditional summaries are checked
against values recomputed from integer counts with absolute tolerance $10^{-10}$.
The fixed x-axis ranges are 0–0.28 for LC and 0–0.12 for other methods; intervals outside
these ranges raise an error. PDFs are written only after all checks pass.

```{r validate-data}
run <- .workflow$slads_execute_workflow("appendix", params)
plot_paths <- run$plot_paths
checked <- run$checked
knitr::kable(checked$validation, digits = 16, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Validated", nrow(checked$data), "cells across", length(run$output_files),
    "figures; valid replications per cell:",
    paste(unique(checked$data$valid), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## Export 8 figures

The figures preserve Appendix C's pair order, panel order, colors and layout.
Blue denotes same-distribution pairs; orange denotes different-distribution pairs.
A vertical dashed line marks 0.05, and a horizontal dashed line separates the first
5 same-distribution pairs from the last 10 different-distribution pairs. Panels run
row-wise: Ky-Fan ($k=1$), Ky-Fan ($k=3$), LC, CLX, CZZW, WZZ. Intervals show pointwise
Monte Carlo uncertainty, not simultaneous confidence bands.

```{r export-pdfs}
output_files <- run$output_files
knitr::kable(data.frame(Figure = basename(output_files),
                        Bytes = file.info(output_files)$size), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Wrote eight vector PDFs to:", plot_paths$figure_dir, "\n")
```
